case.title: Design: the Set Rule question says in all n matrices
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Click the select-all checkbox.
  4. Type 35 in the bar's value.
  5. Click Set Rule.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Every matrix is checked.

Step 4:

  • The value reads 35.

Step 5:

  • The question reads tier A's name "becomes 35% off in all", the number of matrices, "matrices" and the inactive count in brackets, as in picture 2.53.
